name: TixFox – Sell Event Tickets
author: TixFox

sections.description:
TixFox is the most affordable way to sell event tickets on your WordPress site. With a flat $0.39 per ticket fee (no percentage cuts) and instant payouts to your bank account, TixFox helps event organizers keep more of their ticket revenue.

Perfect for conferences, workshops, fundraisers, concerts, festivals, and community events. No monthly fees, no hidden charges—just simple, low-cost ticketing that works seamlessly with the WordPress block editor.

Why Choose TixFox Over Other Ticketing Plugins?

  • Lowest Fees: Flat $0.39 per ticket vs 3-5% + fees on other platforms
  • Instant Payouts: Get paid immediately via Stripe, not weeks after your event
  • No Monthly Fees: Pay only when you sell tickets
  • Reserved Seating: Included free (costs extra on competitors)
  • Full Branding: Your colors, your logo, your event pages

Key Features

  • Event Button Block: Add customizable “Buy Tickets” buttons with cart icons, custom colors, and styles
  • Event Embed Block: Embed complete event details and ticket purchasing forms via iframe
  • Block Editor Integration: Simple drag-and-drop interface in the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg)
  • Customizable Appearance: Adjust colors, button sizes, border radius, and icon visibility
  • Modal-Based Purchasing: Smooth modal experience for ticket purchases on button click
  • Event Management: Browse and select from live, upcoming, and past events
  • Mobile-Responsive Design: Clean, responsive blocks that look great on all devices
  • UTM Parameter Support: Automatic tracking parameter pass-through for marketing analytics
  • QR Code Check-In: Free mobile app for scanning tickets at the door

Perfect For

  • Conferences & Seminars: Professional registration with multiple ticket types
  • Workshops & Classes: Recurring events with simple setup
  • Fundraisers & Galas: Maximize donations with lowest fees
  • Concerts & Festivals: Reserved seating and high-volume sales
  • Community Events: Easy setup for volunteers and organizers
  • Corporate Events: Custom branding and professional appearance

How It Works

  1. Create a free account at TixFox.co and set up your event
  2. Connect your TixFox account via API key in Settings → TixFox
  3. Add TixFox blocks to any post or page using the block editor
  4. Select an event from your TixFox account
  5. Customize the appearance (colors, size, icons)
  6. Visitors can purchase tickets directly from your WordPress site
  7. Get paid instantly via Stripe—no waiting until after your event

External Services

This plugin connects to the external TixFox API (https://tixfox.co) to function. Here’s how it’s used:

  • Service Used: TixFox
  • API Endpoint Base: https://api.tixfox.co/api/
  • Embed URL Base: https://tixfox.co/embed/e/
  • Purpose: The TixFox API is used to:
    • Fetch your events to select from within the block editor
    • Verify your API key for authentication
    • Display event details and ticket purchasing interface on the frontend
  • Data Sent:
    • API Key: Your TixFox API key (obtained from tixfox.co) is sent with API requests for authentication
    • Event Selection: When selecting events in the editor, event data is fetched from the API
    • UTM Parameters: Marketing tracking parameters from the page URL are automatically passed to the TixFox embed
  • Frequency: API calls occur when:
    • Loading the block editor for TixFox blocks (fetching events list)
    • Loading the plugin settings page (verifying API key)
    • Rendering TixFox blocks on the frontend (loading event embed iframes)
  • Terms and Privacy: Use of the TixFox service is subject to their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
    • Terms of Service: https://tixfox.co/legal/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://tixfox.co/legal/privacy

An active TixFox account and API key are required for this plugin to fetch event data and enable ticket purchasing.

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and privacy policy of TixFox. A TixFox account and API key are required for the plugin to function.

Third Party Services Tracking

This plugin does not track any user data or include any tracking mechanisms. All event and ticket data is managed through your TixFox account.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tixfox folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Settings → TixFox
  4. Create a TixFox account at TixFox.co if you don’t have one
  5. Enter your API key from TixFox.co in the settings page
  6. Add the “TixFox Event Button” or “TixFox Event Embed” block to any post or page
  7. Select an existing event from your account
  8. Customize the appearance and save
sections.faq:
How much does TixFox cost?

TixFox charges a flat $0.39 per ticket sold, regardless of ticket price. There are no monthly fees, no setup fees, and no percentage-based charges. Free events are completely free to host. Standard Stripe payment processing fees (2.9% + $0.30) apply separately.

Is TixFox cheaper than Eventbrite?

Yes, significantly. Eventbrite charges 3.7% + $1.79 per ticket, while TixFox charges just $0.39 flat. For a $50 ticket, you save over $3 per ticket with TixFox. For a 500-ticket event, that’s $1,500+ in savings.

How does TixFox compare to other ticketing platforms?

TixFox offers significantly lower fees compared to most platforms. While Eventbrite charges percentage-based fees, and platforms like TicketTailor, SimpleTix, Ticketspice, and TicketSource have varying pricing models, TixFox keeps it simple with a flat $0.39 per ticket. You also get instant payouts via Stripe instead of waiting days or weeks after your event. If you’re currently using another platform and want to try TixFox, you can set up a new event in minutes and embed it on your WordPress site with this plugin.

How fast do I get paid?

TixFox offers instant payouts via Stripe. Unlike other platforms that hold your money until after the event, TixFox deposits funds to your Stripe account within hours of each sale, following standard Stripe payout schedules (typically 1-2 business days to your bank).

Do I need a TixFox account?

Yes, you need to create a free account at TixFox.co to get an API key and manage your events. Account creation takes less than 2 minutes.

Does TixFox work with WooCommerce?

TixFox works independently of WooCommerce and doesn’t require it. The plugin uses native WordPress blocks (Gutenberg) to embed ticket purchasing directly on your pages. This keeps your site faster and simpler than WooCommerce-based solutions.

Can I sell tickets for recurring events?

Yes, TixFox supports recurring events, event series, and multi-day festivals. You can manage all your events from one dashboard and embed any of them on your WordPress site.

Can I customize the appearance of the buttons?

Yes, you can change button colors, adjust sizes, modify border radius, and choose whether to display the cart icon alongside button text. The blocks are designed to match your site’s aesthetic.

What WordPress version is required?

TixFox requires WordPress 5.8 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher. It’s built specifically for the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg).

How does the ticket purchasing work?

For the Event Button block, clicking the button opens a modal with the TixFox ticket purchasing interface. For the Event Embed block, the purchasing interface is embedded directly on the page. Both options provide a seamless checkout experience without leaving your site.

Is there a mobile check-in app?

Yes, TixFox provides free iOS and Android apps for scanning QR code tickets at the door. The app works offline, so you can check in attendees even without internet connectivity.

Can I use TixFox for free events?

Absolutely. Free events have no TixFox fees at all. You can collect RSVPs and registrations without any charges.
